description: Milvus (API, query nodes, storage) and the host it runs on. Pick the server in the dropdown.

panels.title: Milvus status
panels.description: Scrape of the Milvus metrics endpoint. NO DATA = not scraped at all.

panels.title: Query nodes
panels.description: Active query nodes. 0 means nothing can be searched.

panels.title: Collections loaded / total
panels.description: Loaded = collections held in memory and searchable. Total = all collections that exist. A collection that exists but is not loaded cannot be searched until it is loaded.

panels.title: Searchable vectors
panels.description: Entities (vectors) in memory on the query nodes, sealed and growing.

panels.title: Segments loaded
panels.description: Segments loaded by the query nodes.

panels.title: Failed requests (1h)
panels.description: Share of API requests that failed in the last hour. Idle when there were no requests.

panels.title: Search latency p95 (5m)
panels.description: 95th percentile search latency. Idle when nobody searched in the last 5 minutes.

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: Whole host, averaged over all cores.

panels.title: Fullest mount
panels.description: Highest usage across every real mount, including /boot.

panels.title: Root disk free
panels.description: Free space on /. Red under about 10% of the disk, yellow under 20%.

panels.title: Load per core (1m)
panels.description: Load divided by core count. Above 1.0 means more runnable processes than cores.

panels.title: Requests per second by function
panels.description: Replaces the old panel that plotted success and total as separate lines for every function.

panels.title: Failed or abandoned per second
panels.description: Should stay empty. A line here means requests are failing.

panels.title: Search and query latency
panels.description: Gaps mean no requests in that window, not a failure.

panels.title: Searchable vectors by database
panels.description: Sealed = indexed and settled. Growing = recent inserts not yet sealed.

panels.title: Vectors inserted per second by collection
Milvus CPU
panels.description: Percent of ONE core: 100 means one full core, 1600 would be all 16.

panels.title: MinIO bucket size
panels.description: Object storage used by Milvus. It lives on the root disk, so watch Root disk free above.
